unit.why: A single anecdote about the rebbe hosting a crude messenger who came at night with a kvittel for a sick person, illustrating hospitality.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי פ״א שלחו שליח בשביל חולה
stories.summary_en: A messenger arrives at night with a kvittel for a sick man; the rebbe himself feeds him, gives him brandy and bedding, and stops his attendants from expelling the smelly guest, calling it a God-given mitzvah of hospitality.
